meta.title: Globex: SSO outage and missing RCA
meta.summary: A 4-hour SSO outage locks out 900 users. The RCA promised within 5 business days never arrives.

sources.subject: URGENT: nobody can log in via SSO
sources.author: Kenji Watanabe (Globex IT)
sources.body: All of our ~900 users get 'SAML assertion invalid' when logging in via Okta since about 13:00 UTC. Nothing changed on our side. Sev 1.

sources.author: Minh Tran (Support)
sources.body: Hi Kenji, confirmed. We see SAML failures for multiple customers. Treating as P1 incident INC-88. Next update in 30 minutes.

sources.author: Dmitri Volkov (SRE)
sources.body: Root cause looks like the SAML signing cert rotation that ran at 12:58. New cert not published to the metadata endpoint for EU region. Customers pinning the old cert fail.

sources.author: Dmitri Volkov (SRE)
sources.body: Rolling back cert in EU. Need customers on Okta to re-import metadata if rollback doesn't propagate.

sources.author: Minh Tran (Support)
sources.body: Update: identified a certificate rotation issue. Rollback in progress. If login still fails after 15:30 UTC please re-import our SAML metadata in Okta.

sources.author: Kenji Watanabe (Globex IT)
sources.body: Logins are working again after re-importing metadata. We lost about 4 hours of productivity for 900 people. We need a full RCA and what you'll do to prevent this.

sources.author: Minh Tran (Support)
sources.body: Understood and sorry for the impact. Per our incident policy you'll receive a written RCA within 5 business days (by Oct 8).

sources.author: Dmitri Volkov (SRE)
sources.body: Postmortem doc drafted. Action items: staged cert rotation per region, metadata propagation check, customer notice 7 days before rotation. Who's sending the customer-facing RCA?

sources.author: Minh Tran
sources.body: I think the CSM sends RCAs for enterprise accounts? Globex is Sarah's I think.

sources.author: Tom Becker
sources.body: Sarah's OOO till Oct 6, I'm covering. I'll take it once the postmortem is final.

sources.subject: QBR deck
sources.author: Tom Becker (Account Manager)
sources.body: Hi Kenji, attached is the QBR deck for next week. Uptime for the quarter: 99.98%. Looking forward to the session.

sources.subject: Re: QBR deck
sources.author: Kenji Watanabe (Globex IT)
sources.body: Tom, 99.98% uptime? We were locked out for 4 hours two days ago. Does that not count? Also still waiting on the RCA.

sources.author: Dmitri Volkov (SRE)
sources.body: Postmortem finalized and approved. Link in the incident channel. @tom it's ready for the customer version.

sources.author: Kenji Watanabe (Globex IT)
sources.body: It's Oct 9. We were promised an RCA by Oct 8. Nothing received. Our CISO is asking whether we should keep Brightdesk as an SSO-critical system.

sources.author: Lisa Park (VP Customer Success)
sources.body: Globex RCA is overdue and their CISO is involved. Who owned sending it? Tom, Sarah?

sources.author: Tom Becker
sources.body: I handed Globex back to Sarah on Oct 6 when she returned, assumed she'd send it.

sources.author: Sarah Okafor
sources.body: Tom's handback note didn't mention the RCA at all 😬 sending it today.
